claims.statement: Linked objects should be interactive in SVG and the viewer, with a fitting visual cue.
Agents need a way to define links and emphasis that does not get out of control.
Named states emphasize some objects and de-emphasize others, as a user-defined styling layer like the diff view.

claims.notes: Byron 'doesn't fully buy into' it; question 4 checks how far stepping goes.

claims.statement: Views of several states or diagrams: single, small multiples, grid or overlays.
claims.notes: Many states of one file are in scope; multi-file boards and overlays are below the cut line.

claims.statement: States never move anything; all states share one geometry.

human_questions.question: What happens to objects a state does not list?
options: Leave them plain; fade only a dim= list
human_questions.recommendation: Fade them; keep frames of focused members plain.

human_questions.question: What does a relative file href open in the viewer?
options: Raw file in a new tab from the open server
human_questions.recommendation: Editor deep link; .draft opens in the viewer, URLs in a new tab.

human_questions.question: What does inspect --svg draw for a file with states and no flag, and does --states include a plain panel?

provisional_defaults.question: How far toward a walkthrough should states go?
options: File order with [ ] stepping, no captions
provisional_defaults.recommendation: File order with [ ] stepping, no captions.

provisional_defaults.question: For agents working with several diagrams, what comes after states of one file?
options: Multi-file contact sheet (inspect a b c --sheet)
A board file that lists files and states

shape.appetite: Four or five small PRs; no new renderer, no layout change, no walkthrough.
shape.problem: Links are invisible and the viewer cannot open them; one diagram cannot show several emphases.
shape.recommended_shape: Link mark + <a>/<title>/hover in all SVGs and an open chip in the viewer; `state id "label" ids…` lines painted through the existing status layer with focus and dim treatments; --state, --states panels, and a viewer switcher.

dsl_options.name: tags on objects + state by tag

success_moves: Reuse statusPaint/statusSwatch/drawnSwatch with two new treatments instead of a second renderer.
Generalize the compare panel code to N panels; states share one routing pass.
Ship links before states; href already reaches the model.
Keep the active state as view state (URL param), never written to the file.
Prove identical canonicalGeometry across states before any viewer work.

first_proof.question: Can a state paint layer on the diff styling read clearly without moving anything?
first_proof.artifact: inspect --svg --state write on examples/emphasis.draft, rendered with pnpm shoot
first_proof.decision_rule: Continue to --states when geometry equals the plain drawing and dim does not read as removed; else lighten dim first.

rabbit_holes: Overlays of several states in one drawing
Viewer authoring of states before the file form settles

fast_local_loop.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/status.test.ts tests/dsl.test.ts && pnpm draftably inspect examples/emphasis.draft --svg > tmp/out.svg && pnpm shoot tmp/out.svg tmp/out.png

milestones.title: Links look like links in SVG
milestones.done_when: inspect --svg shows mark, tooltip and hover for linked nodes; viewer SVG export keeps <a>.
milestones.outcome: A linked node shows a mark, tooltip and hover in every SVG.
milestones.proof: inspect --svg in a browser; viewer export holds <a>
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; files without the new syntax draw as before.

milestones.title: The viewer opens links
milestones.done_when: Each href kind opens from the chip and Inspector; a plain click only selects.
milestones.outcome: The viewer opens a node link without breaking select.
milestones.proof: Browser proof on tmp/links.draft for url, .draft and path
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Viewer links work; no states yet
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; files without the new syntax draw as before.

milestones.title: Emphasis states and --state
milestones.done_when: Every state has identical canonicalGeometry; check reports bad IDs; skill test passes.
milestones.outcome: A file declares states; the CLI draws one.
milestones.proof: canonicalGeometry equal across states; check flags bad IDs
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: States parse and render in CLI; viewer ignores them
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; files without the new syntax draw as before.

milestones.title: All states as small multiples
milestones.done_when: --states draws aligned panels from one routing pass.
milestones.outcome: The CLI draws every state as aligned panels.
milestones.proof: pnpm shoot sheet of a three-state fixture
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: CLI multi-state output; viewer still single
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; files without the new syntax draw as before.

milestones.title: The viewer switches states
milestones.done_when: Switching changes paint only, ?state= survives reload, edits still save.
milestones.outcome: The viewer switches states and shows a grid.
milestones.proof: window.diagramStudio shows no moves on switch; ?state= reloads
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Full feature; authoring stays in the file
milestones.rollback: Revert the PR; files without the new syntax draw as before.
